name: Escape Room (VST3)
description: A free Windows VST3 noise instrument built as a puzzle. Five coupled noise cells — a geiger cloud, a chaotic FM pair, wandering formants, inharmonic strings, and a crusher that eats the room's own output — through a playable four-voice resonant filter, three traps, and a six-bit lock that rewires the whole machine into any of sixty-four reproducible rooms. Nothing on the panel is labelled with what it does, and there is a legend hidden in the door. Behind the globe: the Brokild World Rack, twelve effect pedals and six SPECTRA characters that take hold of the room itself — the same rack every Brokild synth carries, stored inside each room you save.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260826.5 · free download · 26-page manual included.
